subject: Invoice metadata, timestamping and 7-day portal pilot
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@greentech.co>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greentech AP <ap@greentech.co>, Greentech Procurement <procurement@greentech.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice delivery requirements and VAT tagging (PO 45123)

Hi Kimberly / Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — quick follow up from our AP team. We need to confirm how Redwood will send invoices for the upcoming pilot (PO 45123). A couple of requirements from our side:

- File naming: the PDF filename must include the PO number and invoice date (e.g., 45123_20261201.pdf).
- Timestamp: our systems insist on a visible invoice timestamp in ISO format inside the PDF (invoice issue date + time).
- VAT tagging: if a reverse charge applies, we need a VAT flag in the invoice metadata and presence of the VAT ID on the invoice PDF.
- Delivery: Greentech prefers portal push (SFTP/API) but for the first week we'd like emailed copies for reconciliation.

Can you confirm whether you can meet the filename/timestamp requirement and whether we should enroll in the portal or continue email for now? Also attaching the PO and our vendor enrollment form.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Finance Ops — Greentech Energy Systems
olivia@greentech.co

Attachments: Greentech_PO_45123.pdf; vendor-enrollment-form.pdf

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@greentech.co>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Greentech AP <ap@greentech.co>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery requirements and VAT tagging (PO 45123)

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clarity, and the PO.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support the filename pattern and an ISO timestamp in the invoice PDF; and yes, we can include an explicit VAT reverse-charge flag in invoice metadata. Below are the delivery options and tradeoffs so you can pick what fits your AP workflow: 

1) Portal push (recommended for scale)
   - We push signed PDF + machine-readable XML (with VAT flag) to your SFTP or via webhook to your invoice intake API.
   - Filename convention enforced server-side (we can append or rewrite names to include PO + issue date).
   - Full audit trail and tokenized access; easiest for ongoing volumes.

2) Email copy (good for short pilot)
   - We can send a PDF to ap@greentech.co with the filename you need and include an XML attachment.
   - No guaranteed long-term archive in your AP system unless you enroll the portal.

3) Hybrid (pilot)
   - 7-day pilot: first 3 invoices emailed (with the filename/timestamp), then portal-only from day 8. We can automate the cutover.

Action items we need from you to proceed:
- Confirm desired option (portal / email-only / hybrid pilot).
- Confirm the PO-to-invoice filename pattern (your example is fine).
- Confirm which VAT ID to display on the PDF (your form had two business units).

I attached a short spec that defines the filename rules and the XML element names we will populate (invoice-filename-spec.txt). Connor will follow up on API/SFTP mechanics and the DocuSign link for enrollment exceptions if you need a signed agreement for the filename requirement.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Partnerships — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai

Attachments: invoice-filename-spec.txt

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery requirements and VAT tagging (PO 45123)

Hi Olivia — quick tech note from infra side.

We can support three delivery endpoints (choose one):
- SFTP push (preferred for large volume) — we drop 45123_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS.pdf + 45123_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS.xml.
- Webhook/API POST — invoice payload + base64 PDF and an xml_url, with metadata fields: invoice_id, issue_timestamp (ISO8601), po_number, vat_flag (true/false), vat_id.
- SMTP email — subject line: "Invoice 45123 — Redwood Inference — 2026-12-01T08:00:00Z" and attached PDF with filename per your spec.

I'll attach a small XML sample (invoice-xml-sample.xml) showing the vat_flag element and where we put the invoice_issue_time. If your AP system prefers the ISO timestamp inside the PDF body rendered near the total, we can place a visible timestamp in the human-readable page and embed the exact ISO in the XML.

Regarding the filename contractual ask: if Greentech requires strict filename matching on inbound (i.e., cannot accept alternate names), we typically ask for a short enrollment addendum. I can generate a DocuSign for that; here's a draft link I will send once you confirm the pilot.

Connor O'Brien
Platform Operations — Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai

Attachments: invoice-xml-sample.xml

Thanks — this is exactly the detail our AP team needed. We will go with the Hybrid option: enroll the portal now but please email the first three invoices for PO 45123 to ap@greentech.co using filename pattern 45123_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS.pdf. After the third invoice, switch to portal-only SFTP push (creds to be provided by our IT team).

Please include the VAT ID for Greentech EU (GB999999999) on the PDF and set vat_flag=true in the XML. For the enrollment addendum, we can accept DocuSign — please send the draft and we'll review.

Next steps for you:
- Connor: send SFTP details we should expect for the portal enroll (host, path, fingerprint) so our IT can whitelist.
- Kimberly: confirm the timeline for the first invoice issuance (we expect invoices on 2026-12-01, 2026-12-02, 2026-12-07 for the three pilot copies).

Thanks,
Olivia
